lines.beaver_en: Hello, this is Hanmaeum Mart. How can I help you?
lines.en: I bought this milk because it was on sale.

lines.beaver: 네, 어제까지 할인했어요. 무슨 문제가 있으세요?
lines.beaver_en: Yes, it was discounted until yesterday. Is there a problem?
lines.beaver_roman: ne, eojekkaji harinhaesseoyo. museun munjega isseuseyo?
lines.learner: 날짜가 좀 지난 것 같아요. 교환은 어떻게 해요?
lines.en: It seems a bit past the date. How do I exchange it?
lines.roman: naljjaga jom jinan geot gatayo. gyohwaneun eotteoke haeyo?

lines.beaver_en: I'm sorry. Just bring the receipt and the milk.
lines.en: Here's the receipt. Is the exchange free?

lines.beaver: 네, 무료예요. 같은 우유로 바꿔 드릴게요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, it's free. I'll swap it for the same milk.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, muryoyeyo. gateun uyuro bakkwo deurilgeyo.
lines.learner: 감사해요. 우유가 거의 다 팔린 것 같아요.
lines.en: Thanks. It looks like the milk is almost sold out.
lines.roman: gamsahaeyo. uyuga geoui da pallin geot gatayo.

lines.beaver: 네, 할인이라서 많이 팔렸어요. 다른 건 필요하세요?
lines.beaver_en: Yes, it sold a lot because of the sale. Need anything else?
lines.beaver_roman: ne, hariniraseo mani pallyeosseoyo. dareun geon piryohaseyo?
lines.learner: 마트 안에 자판기도 있어요? 물을 사고 싶어요.
lines.en: Is there a vending machine in the store? I want water.
lines.roman: mateu ane japangido isseoyo? mureul sago sipeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Yes, the vending machine is next to the 1st-floor entrance.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, jadongpanmaegineun ilcheung ipgu yeope isseoyo.
lines.en: Are vending machine drinks discounted too?

lines.beaver: 아니요, 자판기 음료는 할인이 안 돼요.
lines.beaver_en: No, vending machine drinks aren't discounted.
lines.beaver_roman: aniyo, japangi eumnyoneun harini an dwaeyo.
lines.en: I see. And where is the flower shop?

lines.beaver_en: The flower shop is in front of the elevator on the 2nd floor.
lines.en: It's my mom's birthday, so I want to buy flowers.

lines.beaver: 좋네요. 오늘 꽃을 사시면 포장 서비스가 무료예요.
lines.beaver_en: How nice. If you buy flowers today, wrapping is free.
lines.beaver_roman: jonneyo. oneul kkocheul sasimyeon pojang seobiseuga muryoyeyo.
lines.learner: 와, 좋은 서비스네요. 먼저 우유를 교환하면 되지요?
lines.en: Wow, great service. I just exchange the milk first, right?
lines.roman: wa, joeun seobiseuneyo. meonjeo uyureul gyohwanhamyeon doejiyo?

lines.beaver: 네, 바로 바꿔 드릴게요. 즐거운 쇼핑 되세요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, I'll swap it right away. Enjoy your shopping.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, baro bakkwo deurilgeyo. jeulgeoun syoping doeseyo.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll come to this store again.
